steps.observation: You have 10 seconds. Explain the difference between RNA and DNA.

steps.action:
DNA  
• Sugar: deoxyribose (lacks an ‑OH at 2′).  
• Bases: A-T-C-G.  
• Structure: usually double-stranded helix.  
• Role: long-term, stable genetic storage.

RNA  
• Sugar: ribose (has an ‑OH at 2′).  
• Bases: A-U-C-G (uracil replaces thymine).  
• Structure: usually single-stranded, flexible shapes.  
• Role: short-lived working copies and tools (mRNA, tRNA, rRNA, etc.) for protein synthesis and regulation.
